In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover 2 major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
1. Japanese Giant Bets on Yes Bank
Japan’s SMBC plans to acquire a 20% stake in Yes Bank, marking one of the biggest foreign investments in an Indian private bank. This deal follows Yes Bank's dramatic fall from grace and years of recovery after its 2020 bailout led by SBI.
